name: Locked Room on Rails
source:
After finishing his vacation, homicide detective Santiago Moore boards the luxurious express train, The Jacob's Ladder Express, to head back home. However, he's awoken by a sudden murder, and must figure out what happened in this Locked Room on Rails.

[From [url=https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/locked-room-on-rails]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
假期结束后，凶杀案侦探圣地亚哥·摩尔登上豪华特快列车“雅各布天梯特快”回家。然而，他被一场突如其来的谋杀案惊醒，必须弄清楚这个铁轨上锁的房间里到底发生了什么。

[来自[url=https://solarprotagonist.itch.io/locked-room-on-rails]itch.io[/url]]
